disputes.detail: Exact stem: “Under the cited rule, when is interest charged on partners’ drawings?” Option A says “When the deed mentions it.” The cited text states: “No interest is to be charged on the drawings made by the partners, if there is no mention in the Deed.” This supports that a deed mention is necessary for charging (no mention => no charge), and makes A the intended unique option. It does not expressly establish the converse (mention => charge). Read “when” as an only-if condition and A is defensible; read it as a sufficient condition and the excerpt is incomplete. Preserve as disputed wording; do not alter the frozen label.
